title: Amine–Lignocellulose Interaction Atlas (xTB build, v1.0.0)
description: Interactive web atlas of amine–lignocellulose interactions and reaction pathways (DFT and xTB, implicit water): interaction complexes, proton-transfer paths, reaction network and NEB minimum-energy paths for six amines. Serve the folder with any static web server and open index.html.
